systems.system: Integrated National Registration Information System (INRIS) project
systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passports and Citizenship, under the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: planned issue of new biometric National Registration Cards to all citizens, extended to refugees and former refugees in Kalumbila, Nchelenge and Kaoma districts; the project's stated objective is to improve civil registration and identity management through digitisation and automation; card issuance is validated from INRIS

systems.platform: ProGres, UNHCR's registration and case management system
systems.owner: UNHCR, to be transferred to the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: refugees and other persons of concern

systems.system: Refugee ID campaigns with mobile registration camps
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: community-level campaigns in three refugee-hosting districts

systems.system: IT upgrading at Ministry of Home Affairs offices in the three refugee settlements
systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: planned, so that future documentation requests are done locally and digitally without travel to Lusaka

note: The appraisal document counts refugees 'integrated in national civil registration' by identity cards issued; INRIS appears only as the card-issuing project, and nothing states how or where a birth or death is entered. The Birth and Death Registration Act is named once, in a list of laws.
